name: whole-flow-on-a-larger-program
title: A real user's whole flow, on a program big enough to hurt
description: The twelve-session run walked one mode on a tiny library and found seven things, the worst of which is now fixed. This round simulates the whole flow a real user goes through - install, bind, plan, implement, verify, archive - on a program large enough that the agent has to work at scale, and the readings are what it finds. Planning only until the program and the flow are pinned.
creator: aixi
